head.h1: Conference Catering in Dubai — Prices, Formats and What You Get

opening_paragraph: Conference catering in Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 90 per person and keeps a full room of delegates fed and focused from the first arrival coffee to the closing session. The price is quoted to your exact headcount, menu and service level, so a half-day board briefing and a three-day summit are costed on their own terms, not a flat rate. A vetted chef and a trained service team run the food, timing and setup, which means the agenda decides the pace of the day — not the queue at the refreshment table.

replace_in_block.new_heading: What does conference catering in Dubai include?
new_paragraphs: Conference catering includes every food and beverage touchpoint across a working day, delivered on the clock so nothing overruns your programme. As a full-service conference caterer in Dubai we handle arrival refreshments, mid-morning and afternoon breaks, a working lunch or buffet, and continuous tea, coffee and snacks between sessions. Our conference catering services in Dubai cover menu design, a dedicated chef, on-site service or drop-off delivery, table and station setup, and cleanup afterwards. You get one point of contact who holds the run-sheet against your agenda, replenishes stations before they empty, and keeps hot food hot and cold food cold under Dubai's climate. For recurring events, an ongoing arrangement locks in consistent menus and simplified billing.

replace_in_block.block_on_your_page: A Taste of Our Conference Catering
new_paragraphs: MyCHEF was founded by a chef trained in some of Europe's most demanding kitchens, on one idea: you own the event, we carry the work. Vetting for conference catering means identity checks, a practical cooking assessment, reference verification and ongoing performance reviews — a continuous standard, not a one-time tick. We are honest about it, too: no system removes every risk, so we match each event to the chef well suited to it, which is what makes us a conference caterer worth booking, not just a name on a list.

For a corporate programme like this, that might be Ahmed Al-Rashid — 18+ years across Dubai, London and Paris in classical French technique — who designs each menu as a collaboration with the host, every course timed, seasoned and served to exacting standards. We have delivered corporate galas and boardroom dinners across Dubai. Every conference catering booking includes, with client reviews added as events run.
How much does conference catering cost in Dubai?

From about AED 90 per person for a working lunch with break refreshments, around AED 120 for a full event buffet, AED 150 for premium menus or live stations, and AED 700 to AED 950 per person where a chef cooks and serves on site. Minimums are 10 guests on delivered formats, 20 on a buffet, and AED 900 on any order. Multi-day or retained arrangements are priced per programme, not per event.
What is included in conference catering services in Dubai?

Included is menu design, a vetted chef, on-site service or delivery, table and station setup, and cleanup where relevant. Break refreshments, working lunch and continuous tea and coffee are all part of the day.
Can you cater a multi-day conference or a regular programme?

Yes. We rotate menus across a multi-day summit so delegates get a different lunch each day, and for recurring events we set up an ongoing arrangement as your standing conference catering company with consistent menus and simplified billing.
Do you offer halal and dietary-specific conference menus?

Halal is standard on every conference menu, and the kitchen prepares vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut-free and other dietary options alongside the main service. Tell us your delegate mix and we build the menu around it.
Can I hire a private conference chef for on-site cooking?
You can. A private conference chef can run live stations or plated service on site, ideal for a product launch or executive summit where the food is part of the experience, not just fuel.
How far in advance should I book conference catering?

Earlier is better for large or multi-day events, but we regularly handle shorter lead times. Send your dates and headcount and we confirm availability and return an itemised proposal, usually within one business day.
What areas of Dubai do you cover?

We cover the whole of Dubai — DIFC, Business Bay, Downtown, Media City, the World Trade Centre district and beyond — plus private offices and villa meeting rooms, so conference catering near me applies wherever your venue is.
For conference catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

We arrange conference catering across the whole of Dubai, from DIFC and Business Bay boardrooms to Downtown hotels, Dubai World Trade Centre halls, Media City studios and DIFC-adjacent event spaces. If you are searching for conference catering near me, that reach means a local team and delivery route wherever your venue sits, whether it is a city-centre tower or a resort ballroom on the coast. The same service runs at private offices, home boardrooms and villa meeting rooms, so conference home catering for a small executive session is handled with the same rigour as a 300-seat summit. Explore related options like Business Lunch and Corporate Events , or browse corporate catering and catering in Dubai .

add_block.new_heading: Conference catering for corporate events, seminars and multi-day summits
new_paragraphs: Conference catering suits any format where people gather to work, learn or network over several hours or several days. Corporate conference catering in Dubai routinely covers annual general meetings, investor days, product launches, training seminars, panel sessions and industry summits, each with its own rhythm of breaks. For a single-day seminar we build three or four service points around your session times; for a multi-day summit we rotate menus so delegates see a fresh lunch each day. Conference catering for events in Dubai also flexes to hybrid setups — a smaller in-room group plus a speaker green room — and to conference party catering for the closing reception, where canapés and a drinks service replace the working buffet. Whatever the scale, service is timed to the minute so food stays clear of the programme.

add_block.new_heading: What is on the conference menu?
new_paragraphs: The conference menu in Dubai is built around energy, variety and light eating, so delegates stay sharp without a heavy midday slump. A typical day runs from arrival pastries, fresh fruit and specialty coffee, through a mid-morning refresh, into a working lunch of grain bowls, grilled proteins, seasonal salads and warm mains, then an afternoon break of sweet and savoury bites. We design conference food catering around your audience: international buffets for mixed delegations, regional Emirati and Levantine spreads for local dignitaries, and lighter, plant-forward menus for wellness-focused agendas. Halal is standard, and vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and nut-free options are prepared without fuss. Portions and pacing are planned so lunch fuels the afternoon instead of ending it.

add_block.new_heading: Break refreshments, stations and all-day logistics
new_paragraphs: Break service is where conference catering is won or lost, because a 15-minute coffee break has no room for a queue. We stage self-serve stations near the room so 200 delegates clear the line in minutes, then reset and replenish before the next break without entering your session. Barista coffee, loose-leaf tea, infused water and cold-press juices run continuously; sweet and savoury bites rotate through the day to hold interest. For multi-room venues we split stations by floor or breakout so delegates don't walk far, and our team manages waste, linen and layout discreetly. All handling follows Dubai Municipality food-safety practice, with temperature control maintained across long service windows so the last delegate is served as safely as the first.

add_block.new_heading: How to hire conference catering and how it works
new_paragraphs: To hire conference catering in Dubai, send us your dates, venue, delegate count and agenda, and we return an itemised proposal — usually within one business day. From there the process is quick: we confirm the menu and service times, assign your chef and team, and coordinate access, kitchen or prep space and delivery windows with your venue. On the day, the team arrives early to set stations, runs every break and lunch to the run-sheet, and clears down afterwards. If you run conferences regularly, we set up an ongoing arrangement as your standing conference catering company in Dubai, with agreed menus, priority scheduling and consolidated billing. Whether you want a one-off summit handled or a private conference chef on call across a season, the booking path is the same.
